clockSkew.title: Clock Skew
clockSkew.description: Maximum age, in seconds, of a signature, to prevent replay attacks. When '(created)' is signed without '(expires)', it must be within ±clockSkew seconds of the gateway time; when '(expires)' is signed, it must not be in the past and '(created)' must not be more than clockSkew seconds in the future. When neither is signed but the 'Date' header is, the 'Date' header must be within ±clockSkew seconds of the gateway time. Replay protection only applies when 'Date' or '(created)' is signed (use 'enforceHeaders' to require 'Date'). '0' disables these checks.
